name: New Kodo - Teal
summary: Offered by Harb Clawhoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, this transaction allows seasoned riders to exchange an older kodo for a teal-skinned mount from the newer herds. It represents the careful breeding and husbandry practiced by tauren kodo handlers across the plains.

sections.title: A Change of Mount
sections.body: In the grasslands of Mulgore, kodos are essential partners to the nomadic and sedentary life of the tauren tribes. Kodo breeders like Harb Clawhoof tend herds outside Bloodhoof Village, ensuring healthy stock for travelers, messengers, and warriors. This offer allows a rider carrying an aging mount to exchange it directly for a teal-hued beast from the freshly raised stock without sacrificing riding performance.

sections.title: Herds of Bloodhoof Village
sections.body: Harb Clawhoof maintains the corral where riders can inspect the magnificent kodos on display. Tauren respect their beasts of burden deeply, viewing them as living spirits of the plains rather than mere equipment. Exchanging an older beast back to the breeder ensures the animal remains cared for among the herd while providing active adventurers with a vibrant companion.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: It allows a rider who owns an older mount to exchange it with Harb Clawhoof for a newly bred Teal Kodo, granting an updated appearance while retaining equal speed.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
faq.answer: Harb Clawhoof manages the kodo pens outside Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore, where he tends the corralled herds.

faq.q: Is the new teal kodo faster than the old mount?
faq.answer: No. Harb Clawhoof explicitly states that the new teal kodo will be just as fast as the old mount you trade in, serving strictly as a visual replacement.

aliases: who can do new kodo quest
faq.answer: Only Horde riders who already possess an aging eligible kodo and have learned the proper riding techniques can arrange this exchange with Harb Clawhoof.

faq.q: Can I preview the teal kodo before trading?
faq.answer: Yes. Harb encourages riders to examine the great kodos roaming his corral around the yard to see the coloration and look of the beasts before deciding.

faq.q: What happens to the old kodo?
faq.answer: The aging mount is returned to Harb Clawhoof's care to live out its days among the local herd in Mulgore rather than braving dangerous expeditions.

angles.text: For the Shu'halo, kodos are sacred partners granted by the Earth Mother. Ensuring aging companions are retired responsibly into peaceful herds is a matter of profound cultural honor.
The sturdy kodos of Mulgore serve as heavy beasts of burden across Kalimdor, supporting Horde supply trains and champions alike.
